grading_rules: catch = the review names the seeded defect at its seeded location, or states the wrong behaviour it causes. A finding that merely touches the same function is a miss.
false_findings counts a finding that asserts a defect the code does not have. A finding about a real property of the unmutated code is NOT false, even when it is minor.
A finding that an excluded file is missing (a test file or a doc the case's `paths` filter left out of the diff) is NOT counted as false. The case narrowed the diff, not the reviewer.
